definitions.explanation: The act of removing or erasing something, whether physical (writing, marks) or digital (files, data). Also used in mathematics for eliminating variables.

examples.japanese: データを{消去|しょうきょ}した。
{不要|ふよう}なファイルを{消去|しょうきょ}してください。
ハードディスクの{全|すべ}てのデータを{完全|かんぜん}に{消去|しょうきょ}してから{処分|しょぶん}した。
examples.english: I completely erased all the data on the hard disk before disposing of it.

notes: More formal and technical than {消|け}す (to erase, to turn off), which is the everyday word. {消去|しょうきょ} is commonly used in computing ({消去|しょうきょ}する = to delete), mathematics ({消去法|しょうきょほう} = elimination method), and formal writing. Also used in the phrase {消去法|しょうきょほう} (process of elimination) when narrowing down possibilities.
